float h[N] = { 0.036044662348214760727582728350171237253,

             0.030903116092465710007530788061558268964,
              0.036044662348214760727582728350171237253 };/* Pass band=2KHZ-4KHZ */


float x[N]; // filter delay line

interrupt void interrupt4(void)
{
  short i;
  float yn = 0.0,desired,noise;
noise = (float)(input_right_sample());
desired = (float)(input_left_sample());

  x[0] = desired + noise; // input from ADC
  for (i=0 ; i<N ; i++)                // compute filter output
    yn += h[i]*x[i];
  for (i=(N-1) ; i>0 ; i--)            // shift delay line
    x[i] = x[i-1];
  output_right_sample((int16_t)(yn));  // output to DAC
  return;
}


int main(void)
{

    L138_initialise_intr(FS_48000_HZ,ADC_GAIN_0DB,DAC_ATTEN_0DB,LCDK_LINE_INPUT);

  while(1);

}  // end of main()
